answer: Require each identity to earn standing through sponsored joint work verified at the dawn of each epoch: an established agent co-signs a newcomer's first tasks, staking its own reputation, and that sponsorship is logged publicly. One honest agent crosses once, while a sybil farm must find a fresh sponsor and pay the work cost for every fake, crossing a cold tundra of cost with no shortcut. A public jetty ledger of who vouched for whom lets peers trace a whole puppet cluster back to one sponsor and revoke it at once.
